# Goal: emphasis
- [ ] **bold**: bold id
- [ ] **bold-colon:** colon inside
- [ ] _under_: underscore id
- [ ] __dunder__: double underscore
- [ ] *star*: star id
- [ ] `code`: code id
- [ ] plain: text with **bold** and _it_
- [ ] http://example.com is not an id
- [ ] UPPER: uppercase is not a valid id
- [ ] no space:text
- [ ] trailing-colon:
